description: Chief Secretaries Office - Southern Province -Rules under the Co-operative Societies Statutes, No. 06 of 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains detailed regulations and rules for Co-operative Societies under the Southern Provincial Council, specifically enacted under the Co-operative Societies Statutes No. 06 of 2019. The content focuses on establishing a legal and regulatory framework for the registration, operation, membership, and financial management of co-operative societies, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While a minister is named, the primary purpose is to publish regulatory rules rather than focus on the individual's appointment or portfolio responsibilities.
